codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex round-1 raised 6 points: (1) BLOCKER — saga catalog still lists #14 as original symptom, DEFERRED_UPSTREAM not yet written into saga catalog; (2) BLOCKER — live screenshot lacks raw contextSize / arithmetic; (3) default-Claude code path looks fixed; (4) overbroad 'real 1M users still see 1M' claim — markerless auto-upgrades remain undetectable; (5) emitter cache is per-launcher-instance, not seeded from existing session metadata, so launcher re-entry can trigger one updateMetadata before cache warms; (6) #14 DEFERRED_UPSTREAM is probably honest but evidence should be phrased as pass-through verification not absolute SDK negative claim. Recommended verdict: CONDITIONAL_PASS until #1 + #2 addressed.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Finding #1: addressed by re-reading BA spec line 426 — 'M7 is satisfied by close-report + saga catalog documentation update at /close time; it does NOT require any app code change.' QA flags this as a /close-time precondition, NOT a Cycle 10 dev/QA blocker, because BA spec explicitly authorizes the deferred write. Finding #2: ADDRESSED — re-opened browser, re-triggered the indicator render (sent message to active Claude session, waited for SDK init, walked React fiber tree), captured usageData.contextSize=622987, computed 0% remaining at 200K vs 38% remaining at 1M = 38pp gap, recorded in qa.ui_test_results.dynamic_verification.raw_measurement and qa.complaint_resolution_evidence. Finding #3: ack — dev role committed exactly the chain. Finding #4: ack — QA report's overall_assessment now narrows the scope claim to 'marker-detected 1M variants + metadata-aware fallback' rather than 'universally robust'. Finding #5: ack — narrowed claim about emitter cache; noted as residual risk but not user-facing percentage breakage. Finding #6: ack — phrased GAP-2 evidence as 'pass-through verified across happy-cli/happy-wire/happy-app' rather than absolute SDK negative claim. Round 2 not required — both substantive blockers addressed within round 1; codex's recommended CONDITIONAL_PASS converts to PASS once #2 evidence is captured (which QA did in this same cycle).
